sourceQuote: The applicants who intend to pursue master degree in GDPU must be under the age of 35 with bachelor degree, official transcript and two recommendation letters by professors or associate professor of graduate school are requested.
targetQuote: 拟在GDPU攻读硕士学位的申请人年龄须低于 35，并须持有学士学位，同时提交正式成绩单以及两封由研究生院教授或副教授出具的推荐信。
